headline: Weathered Expanse Foothold Erased as Palantine Berm Fighting Persists
war_summary: The Colonial post in Weathered Expanse is gone. That northern field now stands at seven Warden works, none Colonial and two unclaimed, after thirty-nine ownership actions in the day and eight in the past six hours around Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest; its casualty rolls remain the war's heaviest, past seven thousand five hundred Colonial and eight thousand four hundred Warden in twenty-four hours. Palantine Berm has reversed its ledger, now four Warden works to three Colonial where the last edition found the opposite, with forty-eight actions in the day and three in the final two hours at Vendett and Windburn Landing. Linn Mercy holds nine Colonial works, one Warden and one neutral, thirty-one actions in the day and six in six hours; Lathair and Outwich Ranch carry the burden. Marban Hollow counts twenty-nine actions, nearly all at Checkpoint Bua, standing four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral. Stonecradle logs eighteen, twelve inside six hours at The Dais, with one Warden work against eight Colonial. Stlican Shelf has flared anew, five actions in two hours and eight in the day, its two Warden works against seven Colonial. Thirty-four towns remain for victory.
